question: Summarize the main research contribution of 'Retrieval-Augmented Large-Language-Model-Based Time-Series Forecasting for Cross-Market Equity Analysis'.
ground_truth: Abstract Time-series foundation models and retrieval-based augmentation have recently emerged as relevant tools for financial forecasting, yet it remains unclear when explicit historical retrieval helps a pre-trained probabilistic forecaster in noisy equity settings.
